g.text: OpenVela / NuttX: where each contract lives
OV1 · Representative local device path · flat-build interpretation; protection variants are in OV2
A POSIX-shaped call is not a portable device protocol. These columns are responsibilities, NOT process or protection boundaries.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
